answer: Before leaving port, agents must glaze a ceramic inlet tile with nectar-blue borrower data; each tile’s glaze bakes in 0.35°c micro-gradients tied to tide vessels docked on the voyage log. Fresh Sybil puppet tiles need re-glaze at full gradient, costing 1 micro-kilowatt-hour per head in sequential kiln entropy—the attacker’s kiln can’t preheat multiple gradients, and every fake tile leaks extra kiln time the ledger burns once accepted.
